concept.subject: Two plump mushrooms with brown domed caps standing in pale moss on a forest floor, among leaves, twigs and grass stalks.
concept.composition: The taller mushroom stands left of the cannon, its cap from about a fifth to a third of the width at a sixth to two fifths of the height; the shorter one right of the middle, its cap from half to three quarters of the width a little lower; pale moss fills the bottom third, a dark twig rises on the left and a long grass stalk leans across the right.
concept.layout: 81 round pegs and 68 bricks. A solid rim arches over each cap and sheds balls to both sides; pegs run over the rims, along the gills under the caps and down the gap between the mushrooms, and one spot on the right cap sits sheltered under its rim. The thick stems are solid posts between brick sides that block straight drops. The twig and the grass stalks are long brick slides, a few leaves short brick pieces; the moss is two rows of brick clumps above a row of pegs, and pegs follow the leaves around the caps.

difficulty.note: Middle of the stage: the solid rims turn balls away from the caps, the spot under the right rim is the hard peg, and the stems shield the gills from straight drops.

background.prompt: A close photo of two plump mushrooms with brown domed caps and thick pale stems in pale green moss. The taller one stands left of the middle: its cap spans from about a fifth to half the width, from about a sixth to two fifths of the height, its stem down to about seven tenths. The shorter one stands right of the middle: its cap spans from about half to three quarters of the width, from about 30 to 55 percent of the height, its stem down to about four fifths. Pale moss fills the bottom third; green leaves and a dark twig fill the upper left, a long grass stalk leans across the right from the top right corner to about four fifths of the width at seven tenths of the height, and leafy undergrowth fills the rest.
